about.title: Find here the perfect balance between style and comfort
about.description:
Crafted with the modern business traveler in mind, Signature Hotel Al Barsha perfectly balances style and comfort to create one of the top places to stay in Dubai. Ideally located on Sheikh Zayed Road, just a short walk from the Mall of the Emirates and Insurance Market Metro Station, it offers a blend of comfort and convenience.
Whether you're here for business or leisure, Signature Hotel Al Barsha delivers exceptional services, making it the ideal choice for your stay. With 90 contemporary 4-star rooms and suites and comprehensive facilities, including an outdoor swimming pool, gym, salon, clubs and outdoor swimming pool, you'll find everything you need for a memorable experience. Just 400 meters from the metro and a five-minute stroll to the renowned Mall of the Emirates with over 600 outlets, our location places you at the heart of Dubai's dynamic offerings.

about.title: Enjoy our breathtaking waterfront views and exceptional service
about.description:
Experience the best of Dubai Marina at Signature Hotel Apartments and Spa, where breathtaking waterfront views and exceptional service come together to create the perfect setting for both business and leisure stays in Dubai United Arab Emirates.
Located just a short stroll from DMCC Metro Station and JBR Beach, our hotel offers the ultimate in affordable comfort at the heart of Dubai Marina. Choose from 95 elegantly furnished apartments in four distinct categories: Superior Studio Apartments, Villas, One-Bedroom Apartments, and Two-Bedroom Apartments, all designed with your relaxation in mind.
Indulge in a culinary journey at our all-day dining restaurant and café, offering a mesmerizing view of the Marina waterfront. With a diverse menu featuring buffet and à la carte options for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, you'll enjoy a dining experience that perfectly complements your stay in our self-contained, spacious apartments, complete with modern amenities and stylish fittings.

details.title: Rooms with Dubai Canal View
details.fullDescription: Experience the ultimate luxury living at Royal Continental Suites, where you can have an amazing Canal View with Burj Khalifa as your backdrop. Imagine waking up to the stunning sight of the iconic Dubai skyline right outside your window. Royal Continental Suites offers a stunning choice for travelers seeking a hotel apartment with a canal view. This property features elegantly designed accommodations that overlook the picturesque canal, providing guests with a serene and scenic backdrop. Each hotel apartment with a canal view at Royal Continental Suites is thoughtfully appointed to ensure maximum comfort and luxury, allowing guests to enjoy both the beauty of the water and the convenience of modern amenities. Whether you’re staying for business or leisure, the breathtaking canal views enhance the experience, making Royal Continental Suites a standout choice for those seeking a memorable stay.

At Royal Continental Suites, guests can enjoy access to the luxurious Royal GYM services. This state-of-the-art fitness center offers top-of-the-line equipment and amenities for those looking to stay active during their stay. From cardio machines to free weights, there is something for every type of workout enthusiast.

details.fullDescription: At Babati, our mission is to bring a unique interpretation of Lebanese cuisine to Dubai. Located in Business Bay with mesmerizing views of the Dubai Water Canal, our restaurant in Dubai is a dining destination that offers a taste of true Levantine cuisine with its characteristic blend of fresh herbs and flavorful spices. Lebanese cuisine has always found its unique place in the broader umbrella of Levantine cuisine. Our chefs have made it their mission to bring out the charm of Lebanese cuisine using modern techniques and high-quality ingredients. Acquaint your tastebuds with a plethora of flavours and textures that you have never enjoyed before!
